label: Genlock Video — Structured (Seedance / VEO / Kling)
description: Structured video prompt in the canonical Genlock frame: subject, action, scene, shot, camera, lighting, color_palette, style. Serialized to the target model's JSON (the SEEDANCE/VEO/KLING shape). Runs via Higgsfield.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Who or what is in the shot. Reuse character-lock text verbatim when no reference sheet or Soul ID is available.

action.label: Action
action.description: What happens, with kinetic verbs. Cover the clip's timeline.

color_palette.label: Color Palette
color_palette.description: Array of palette descriptors, e.g. ["jet black", "tungsten amber"].

start_image.label: Start Frame
start_image.description: First frame for image-to-video. Maps to shot.startFrameImage.

end_image.label: End Frame
end_image.description: Last frame for guided generation. Maps to shot.endFrameImage.

prompt_assembly.template: {{subject}}. {{action}}. Scene: {{scene}}. Shot: {{shot}}. Camera: {{camera}}. Lighting: {{lighting}}. Palette: {{color_palette}}. Style: {{style}}.

v_setup_injection.note: v_setup is fallback context. Prefer the structured shot/camera/lighting fields when populated.

llm_instructions.writing_guide: Author the prompt as the canonical Genlock video frame, then Genlock serializes it to the target model's JSON. Fill subject + action always; populate scene/shot/camera/lighting/style/color_palette as structured objects (see docs/_recent/prompts-examples.md for the SEEDANCE/VEO/KLING shape). Keep style language consistent across shots in a sequence. Default duration 6s for short beats, 15s for full sequences. Default NO MUSIC unless asked. Do not put the word 'camera' inside the camera.movement string for Seedance.

field_guides.subject: Character-lock description verbatim if no reference sheet/Soul ID; otherwise keep short.
field_guides.action: Kinetic verbs covering the clip timeline. For 15s sequences, break into beats.
field_guides.scene: { setting, time_of_day, atmosphere } — one phrase each.
field_guides.shot: { type, angle, lens, framing } — e.g. type 'wide', angle 'eye-level', lens '35mm', framing 'subject centered third'.
field_guides.camera: { movement, speed } — e.g. movement 'slow dolly-in', speed 'slow'.
field_guides.lighting: { key, mood, color_temperature } — describe the key light, emotional mood, and color temperature.
field_guides.style: { look, references, grain } — overall look, reference titles, and film grain.
field_guides.model: seedance_2_0 cinematic narrative; veo3_1 high quality; veo3_1_lite budget/quick; kling3_0 fast stylized.

do: Keep style consistent across a sequence
Use start_image from shot.startFrameImage for image-to-video continuity
Default to NO MUSIC unless the user asks
dont: Re-describe a character's face when a reference sheet or Soul ID anchors identity

x-genlock-surface.tagline: Structured video prompt in the canonical Genlock frame: subject, action, scene, shot, camera, lighting, color_palette, style. Serialized to the target model's JSON (the SEEDANCE/VEO/KLING shape). Runs via Higgsfield.
